title: FoConvertors
description: Add FULLY Customizeable Convertors for ANYTHING within a FEW Clicks.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/342c87ca73e716c472f13559ca78d06464f0d12f.png)
**Turn special convertor items into automatic inventory converters so players can transform materials on the fly with zero command spam.**

FoConvertors is a lightweight Paper/Spigot/Purpur plugin for servers that want configurable item-to-item conversion loops. Give players convertor items, let them toggle each convertor on or off, and have matching items converted automatically while they play.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2b27cfa9bdcd60ad93571bc347af4da7eb73a38.png)

## Features
- Create custom convertor templates for any item pair (input item + amount to output item + amount).
- Convert items automatically while players move loot in their inventory, pick items up, swap hands, or re-organize stacks.
- Toggle each convertor item with a left-click, with configurable cooldown and optional toggle feedback messages.
- Require convertors in offhand only or allow active convertors from inventory, based on your server setup.
- Use strict item-meta matching (name/lore/enchant-aware) for precise conversion control.
- Manage everything in-game with an admin GUI editor: create, edit, enable-by-default, and delete templates.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd1956e09bc72a6118d4b54beea31410dfd0b0f5.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/469aac9b524828eaaee8ebfd8905e36fbda7862b.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dfc89b3a16615de96d2780cd9bc18c863676f55.png)

## Commands
- `/foconvertors version` - Show plugin author and version
- `/foconvertors editor` - Open the convertor editor GUI (admin)
- `/foconvertors give <player> <convertorId> [amount]` - Give convertor items (admin)
- `/foconvertors reload` - Reload config and templates (admin)
- Alias: `/convertors`

## Permissions
- `foconvertors.admin` - Access admin commands and editor

Optional admin tools include configurable toggle messaging, conversion-per-pass limits, and offhand-only enforcement for tighter balancing.
